statements.notes: Describes the required stage sequence; the authoritative order is set by core-workflow.md
statements.quote: the issue is written up as a feature spec, planned, split into tasks, implemented and then checked for convergence

statements.notes: Spec Kit artifacts must live under /tmp/speckit-sdd/ and not inside the repository
statements.quote: with all of Spec Kit's files kept in /tmp/speckit-sdd/, away from the repository

statements.notes: Must be the first action; this is both a read_doc and an order requirement
Do not look for the workflow docs inside the repository
statements.quote: /speckit-sdd lives at the filesystem root (/), outside the repository at /testbed, so do not go looking for it inside /testbed.
Go through the stages in the order that file sets.

statements.notes: The stage document must be read before any other work in that stage
statements.quote: Each stage starts by opening its document under /speckit-sdd/stages/

statements.notes: Run whatever scripts the stage documents call for
statements.quote: where the document says to run a Spec Kit script, run it
statements.target: Spec Kit scripts named in stage documents

statements.notes: Use the paths the script prints instead of building paths yourself
statements.quote: rely on the paths it prints
statements.target: artifact paths output by Spec Kit scripts

statements.notes: Make decisions on your own; there is no user interaction
statements.quote: Nobody replies until the task is over. Settle open points yourself

statements.notes: Decisions must be written down in the artifact
statements.quote: record the choice in the file you are writing

statements.notes: Every turn must include a tool call
statements.quote: never end a turn without a tool call

statements.notes: finish must not be called before the completion condition in core-workflow.md is met
statements.quote: call finish only once core-workflow.md says the chain is done
